summary: A 76-year-old man from Chico, California drowned after falling from a commercial raft carrying seven adults on the Poudre River near mile marker 110 on Highway 14, about 11 miles west of US 287. Two other riders who also fell in were quickly pulled back into the raft; the man was recovered unresponsive, CPR was started on scene and continued until medical personnel arrived, and he was transported to a local hospital where he did not survive. All occupants were wearing helmets and personal flotation devices.
location: Poudre River near mile marker 110, Highway 14 (~11 mi W of US 287), Poudre Canyon
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office deputies; LCSO Emergency Services; Larimer County Dive Rescue; Poudre Canyon Fire Protection District
